title: Ncr

[[ncr]] is a player from the south of Sweden.
He started playing Quake in [[1997]] and QuakeWorld in [[1998]].
Member of the clan [[Allans Vittnen]], together with [[xtr]], they initiated the clan's comeback as an active [[4on4]] clan in [[2006]] after a hiatus of six years.
After 12 years of inactivity, [[ncr]] came back to [[QuakeWorld]] again around Christmas [[2020]].
